messages:
incident-bot: <@jade> Paging: Elevated 5xx rate detected for service ai-infer (gateway errors + timeouts). Alert: 5xx spike from 03:12 -> 03:18 UTC, ~18% error rate, p95 latency up. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/ai-infer/overview :rotating_light:

jade (oncall): I'm taking this. seeing 502/504 from gateway logs, and a lot of downstream ECONNRESET to the model pool. anyone touching LB/Envoy routes in last ~2h?

samir patel: I rolled a route weight change at 03:05 to shift a small traffic slice to the new canary pool (ai-infer-canary). It also bumped retry_count from 1 -> 3 in the new envoy route config to reduce transient failures.

maria chen: oof retries + overloaded canary = classic retry amplification. can we revert retry_count on the gateway?

alex k: We can patch envoy route on the gateway quickly. suggest disabling retries at LB for the route and drain canary traffic back to stable.

jade (oncall): plan: 1) disable retries on gateway for ai-infer route 2) shift traffic off canary (80% stable) 3) increase CB thresholds temporarily to avoid mass ejections 4) add short-term autoscale for model pool. executing in that order.

samir patel: +1. I can do the weight shift and CB tweak. maria, can you trigger the config patch for retries?

maria chen: on it. patching envoy config now. command: ```kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-gateway -p '{"data":{"ai-infer-route":"retry_policy: disabled"}}'``` applying.

deploy-bot: deploy started: configmap/envoy-gateway patch by maria chen at 03:22 UTC. rollout to gateway pods pending.

jade (oncall): samir, please shift canary -> stable weights to 10% canary / 90% stable. do a gradual step to 50/50 if metrics stable, but start conservative.

samir patel: doing weight shift via traffic controller: ```trafficctl set-weight ai-infer canary=10 stable=90 --reason "mitigation: retry amplification"``` executed at 03:24.

alex k: I pushed a temporary circuit-breaker change to cluster ai-infer-cluster: max_connections + pending_requests increased by 50% to reduce ejects. Applied via envoy admin: ```curl -X POST http://envoy-admin.local/cluster/ai-infer-cluster/reconfigure -d '{"cb":{"max_connections":2000}}'```

jade (oncall): monitoring: please watch 5xx rate and p95 latency on Grafana. if errors drop under 2% for 10m, we can keep changes as mitigation and open a postmortem.

maria chen: gateway pods report config reload success. deploy-bot: rollout succeeded at 03:26.

samir patel: metrics update: 03:27 -> 5xx from 18% -> 9% (half). p95 latency improving.

jade (oncall): good. continue monitoring. also check any model pool OOMs or restarts in canary.

alex k: logs from ai-infer-canary show high retry storm and TCP resets to model-backend. looks like canary instances became saturated, leading to upstream 502s.

samir patel: shifting more off canary to stable now: trafficctl set-weight canary=5 stable=95 at 03:30.

maria chen: 03:33 grafana: 5xx down to 3.5%, p95 back near baseline. Looks promising.

jade (oncall): great. decision: keep retries disabled on gateway for now, keep canary at 5%, and keep CB higher for 30m. initiate scaling for canary pool by +2 replicas to reduce pressure. samir, can you scale?

samir patel: scaling ai-infer-canary deployment +2 replicas. kubectl scale --replicas=5 deployment/ai-infer-canary -n inference. scaling started at 03:35.

deploy-bot: scale event recorded for deployment/ai-infer-canary (from 3 -> 5) by samir patel at 03:35 UTC.

alex k: hooking up a temporary traffic shadow to log failing requests for postmortem: shadow -> ai-infer-debugger. will keep payload trimmed.

jade (oncall): customer impact: working with account team to notify any customer with >1% error increase. list: acct-42, acct-87 flagged by monitor. maria, can you draft message?

maria chen: drafting now: "We observed elevated errors impacting inference calls between 03:12-03:35 UTC. Mitigation applied; error rates back near baseline. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with detailed postmortem." sending to SRE runbook for review.

samir patel: scale completed; new pods passed readiness at 03:39.

jade (oncall): final metrics: 03:40 snapshot -> 5xx = 1.1%, p95 latency within SLA. marking incident as mitigated.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated: ai-infer 5xx spike (mitigation actions: retries disabled, traffic shifted off canary, CB thresholds increased, canary scaled). Timeline: 03:12 detection -> 03:40 mitigated.

jade (oncall): postmortem owners: samir (traffic change root cause), alex (envoy config & CB tuning), maria (customer comms). action items: - revert temporary CB and scaling after stability - run canary config audit (retries change) - add automated gating for retry policy changes (alerts before rollout).

samir patel: noted. I'll open the follow-up ticket and assign.

maria chen: posted customer message, kept support cc list updated.

alex k: adding logs and shadowed requests to ticket for debugging.

jade (oncall): thanks all. closing thread, will reopen if regression. :thumbsup:
